typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CALL_STATUS as string,
		PRINCIPAL as string,
		COUNTERPARTY as string,
		WELLSAFARGO_MTM as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_MTM as string,
		ACTION as string,
		CALL_AMOUNT as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_AMOUNT as string,
		DISPUTE_VALUE as string,
		DIRECTIONAL_DISPUTE_AGE as string,
		DISPUTE_VALUE_USD as string,
		DISPUTE_SPREAD_USD as string,
		COUNTRY_OF_RISK as string,
		BASE_CURRENCY as string,
		FX_RATE as string,
		AGREEMENT_TYPE as string,
		VMRULE_COMPLIANT as string,
		IMRULE_COMPLIANT as string,
		DISPUTE_TYPE as string,
		EVENT_DATE as string,
		REGION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> KRIDailyDisputes	source(output(
		Filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupFilenameLKPTABLE
KRIDailyDisputes derive(BusDate_drv = toString((substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(30), toInteger(8)))),
		Loaddate_drv = toString((currentTimestamp())),
		FileName_drv = toString(($sFileName))) ~> GetfilenameBusinessDate
GetfilenameBusinessDate derive({Copy of BusDate_drv} = BusDate_drv) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupFilenameLKPTABLE lookup(FileName_drv == Filename,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupFilename
LookupFilename filter(!isMatch()) ~> LookupFilename0
LookupFilename0 sink(input(
		agreementType as string,
		fileName as string,
		disputeValueUSD as string,
		fxRate as string,
		directionalDisputeAge as string,
		imRuleCompliant as string,
		wellsFargoMTM as string,
		callAmount as string,
		counterpartyAmount as string,
		disputeType as string,
		vmRuleCompliant as string,
		baseCurrency as string,
		counterpartyMTM as string,
		countryOfRisk as string,
		principal as string,
		busDate as string,
		disputeValue as string,
		callStatus as string,
		counterparty as string,
		action as string,
		loaddate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		region as string,
		disputeSpreadUSD as string,
		eventDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		agreementType = AGREEMENT_TYPE,
		fileName = FileName_drv,
		disputeValueUSD = DISPUTE_VALUE_USD,
		fxRate = FX_RATE,
		directionalDisputeAge = DIRECTIONAL_DISPUTE_AGE,
		imRuleCompliant = IMRULE_COMPLIANT,
		wellsFargoMTM = WELLSAFARGO_MTM,
		callAmount = CALL_AMOUNT,
		counterpartyAmount = COUNTERPARTY_AMOUNT,
		disputeType = DISPUTE_TYPE,
		vmRuleCompliant = VMRULE_COMPLIANT,
		baseCurrency = BASE_CURRENCY,
		counterpartyMTM = COUNTERPARTY_MTM,
		countryOfRisk = COUNTRY_OF_RISK,
		principal = PRINCIPAL,
		busDate = {Copy of BusDate_drv},
		disputeValue = DISPUTE_VALUE,
		callStatus = CALL_STATUS,
		counterparty = COUNTERPARTY,
		action = ACTION,
		loaddate = Loaddate_drv,
		region = REGION,
		disputeSpreadUSD = DISPUTE_SPREAD_USD,
		eventDate = EVENT_DATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
